relationships.description: 1. Opens dashboard and submits unique car ID
2. Requests access to register a car
4. Checks if car ID already exists
6. Requests basic car data by ID
7. Downloads car info (brand, model, motor, weight)
8. Sends cleaned car data for storage
10. Confirms registration and redirects to car info page
11. Fills and submits new sensor configuration (part, unit, frequency)
12. Requests access to add sensor configuration
14. Updates sensor configuration for the car
16. Sends confirmation (or error message) to user
